findings.current: The owner had gone out on a limb and asked for two hundred nyang, only for me to counter with three hundred. From his perspective, he probably had no idea what kind of person I was.
findings.defect: The assembled English omits the preceding detail that only part of the third-floor railing and wall had collapsed. This establishes how limited the damage was before the narrator explains the owner’s reaction.
findings.rationale: The Korean says only part of the third-floor railing and wall had collapsed. The accepted baseline preserves this physical detail; the assembled copy drops it.
findings.replacement: Insert before this span: “At most, part of the third-floor railing and a section of the wall had collapsed.”

summary: The translation is faithful overall, but it omits a source detail describing the limited extent of the damage, which the accepted baseline preserved.
